name: Data Recipe: Weekly Google Trends keyword report

parameters.content:
## Weekly keyword trend report -> Google Sheets
Every Monday the [Google Trends Scraper](https://apify.com/fast_data_asap/google-trends-scraper) pulls 90 days of Google Trends data for your keywords. A Code node turns it into one row per keyword (this week vs. last week, change %, peak, rising queries) and appends it to a sheet, so you build a trend history over time.

**Setup (5 min)**
1. *Get Google Trends*: Header Auth credential `Authorization` = `Bearer <Apify API token>`.
2. Edit `searchTerms` and `geo` (empty = worldwide). More than 5 terms work.
3. *Append to Google Sheets*: pick your spreadsheet, tab `Trends`.

Cost: $0.003 per result. 3 keywords = 4 results = $0.012 per week.
